profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Los Angeles Superior Court
profile.summary: I'm always willing and ready to take on a challenge. Being eager to move forward and having the will to learn new things is a positive characteristic to have. Communication is something I feel comfortable with, I don't mind speaking with new people and creating new acquaintances within the work environment just like in my personal life. My current objective is to be able to step foot into the web development field and begin to use my knowledge in collaborating with a team in creating web projects. Giving 110% all the time is a top priority for me.

positions.title: Senior Front End Web Developer
positions.description: My responsibilities at Hawke were to bring wireframes to life either on Shopify or WordPress platform for multiple clients. Also creating custom landing pages from the ground up and implementing custom tracking pixels along the way, example: Facebook conversion pixel and Google Analytics. The programming languages that were used were HTML5, CSS3, PHP, JavaScript and Ruby. Handled up to 10 clients at once from the discovery phase through the launch and delivered stunning websites for the clients. Examples of work available upon request.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I was given wordpress or custom website projects remotely. All of my assignments were given to me via email, phone conference were required once in a while to touch bases on what projects were being worked on and which w=ones were next. Depending on the project I would then proceed to customize it according to the client’s request that were supplied to me via email. The projects were based off of HTML5, CSS3 and PHP depending on what type of functionality the project needed.

positions.title: Web Developer/Graphic Designer
positions.description: My responsibilities at Clinica Medica General are to create an interactive website for the various departments that they have. Amongst designing and creating each website my other responsibility is to give analytical reports about the traffic going through each website every month. I also create flyers for events that are held at the clinic, whether it is a health fair or a plastic surgery consultation fair. Other types of design media I created were used in advertisements that are printed in house for distribution at any of the six clinics.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant/Machine Operator/Shipping Clerk
positions.description: I did administrative assistant work at Aero such as filling, data entry, answering phones. Another part of my job is being a machine operator which I run machines that punch out aluminum parts to get ready for fabrication. In shipping I package finished product that goes out to our customers. Receiving is also part of my daily duties. I'm in charge of keeping countability via PC of the hardware that is installed on all the parts manufactured at Aero.

positions.title: Video Games Editor/Writer/Web Designer (Remote)
positions.description: At VGRevolution I created topics/articles for upcoming video game titles. Many of the video games required a review to be done, which I would spend about a week playing the game taking notes about it and turning that around and creating a review article. After that I used a point system to give it a score on a scale from 1-10. The reviews where not limited to just video games, I also did reviews on gaming peripherals such as headphones, mouse’s, speakers, etc. Revising articles for spelling, grammatical and web design was also part of my job.

positions.title: PC Technician
positions.description: I was deploying PC systems by contract for Dell to all greater Los Angeles YMCA's.

positions.title: Board Technician
positions.description:
I was a board technician/auditor of 20 people. I had to double check everyone's work and assure that all chips and charging ports were soldered correctly and that the phone passed the functionality tests.

• Repaired cellular phone main boards. 
• Audit 30 technicians repaired boards made sure that they where soldered correctly, and the prior issues to repairing the board where resolved. 
• Repaired LCD's so they would function correctly when completely assembled. 
Supervisor: Danny Lou 
(323) 722-7808
